data.one_liner: Thin wrapper around Dart Isolates implementing the Actor Model
data.what_it_does: Makes working with Dart Isolates easier by wrapping them in an Actor model. Supports maintaining private internal state, streaming responses, and managing groups of actors with different strategies.
use_when: You need to offload CPU-intensive tasks to separate isolates easily
You want to manage isolated states with message passing
avoid_when: You are targeting the web where this library's worker implementation is not yet complete
Simple asynchronous async/await without isolates is sufficient for your workload
strengths: Supports stateful actors and actor groups with strategies like RoundRobin and MultiHandler
Provides a unified Messenger interface for local and isolated execution
weaknesses: Web support is currently a TODO
Passing actors via Sendable adds a small performance overhead
